claims: Treat hypotension with norepinephrine infusion and titrate to maintain mean arterial pressure, reassessing hemodynamics frequently.

Replete magnesium given magnesium level of 1.9 mg/dL.
Adjust oxygen therapy to maintain SpO2 above target, given SpO2 89-93% on high-flow oxygen (FiO2 80%, 10 L/min).

Monitor blood glucose given glucose values 83-144 mg/dL.
Continue isotonic fluid administration (0.9% sodium chloride) as ordered.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess acid-base status and oxygenation given pH 7.45, pCO2 29, base excess -1, and lactate 0.6.
Perform ongoing neurologic assessments (GCS, RASS, CAM-ICU) given current alert and oriented status.
Maintain bed rest with fall precautions given bedfast status and limited mobility.
